# Miracle Performance
> Elite fitness gym in Beachwood, Ohio offering strength training, conditioning classes, infrared recovery, and personal training. Founded 20 years ago by Nate Miracle.

## About
Miracle Performance (mpcle.com) is a boutique group fitness and personal training gym located at 23400 Mercantile Rd, Suite 5, Beachwood, OH 44122. Phone: 216-832-9212. Email: nate@mpcle.com.

We offer small-group coached classes designed to help members move better, get stronger, and recover faster. This is not a big box gym.

## Classes & Offerings
- MP Strength: Barbell and strength-focused group training
- Met-Con Circuit: Metabolic conditioning and cardio circuits
- BoxFit: Boxing-inspired conditioning
- MP Climb: VersaClimber-based cardio training
- Redwave IR Active Recovery: 30-minute guided post-workout recovery session using infrared heat, red light therapy, soft tissue work, spinal decompression, and Active Isolated Stretching
- Redwave Premium Classes: Group classes held inside the Redwave Infrared Studio combining training with infrared and red light therapy benefits
- Semi-Private Training: Small group personal training sessions

## The Redwave Infrared Studio
The Redwave Infrared Studio is a dedicated recovery space at Miracle Performance featuring infrared heat, red light therapy (630-850nm wavelengths), and guided recovery programming. Post-workout recovery sessions are 30 minutes and include 5 phases: Nervous System Reset, SMFR/Mobility, Spinal Decompression, AIS Flexibility, and IR + Red Light Recovery with Diaphragmatic Breathing. Sessions are accompanied by 174 Hz Solfeggio frequency music.
